steps.sql: CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS EVENT_DETAILS (ORG_ID CHAR(32) NOT NULL, CONFIG_KEY CHAR(32) NOT NULL, COMPONENT_NAME VARCHAR(512) NOT NULL, REQUEST_ID CHAR(32) NOT NULL, UPDATE_DATE INT NOT NULL, UPDATE_TIME INT NOT NULL, CLIENT CHAR(16) NOT NULL, STATUS INT NOT NULL, EVENT_DATA VARCHAR(1024), MESSAGE VARCHAR(512), INSERTED_TIME TIMESTAMP DEFAULT CURRENT_TIMESTAMP NOT NULL, INDEX STATE_INDEX (UPDATE_DATE, UPDATE_TIME, ORG_ID, CONFIG_KEY, COMPONENT_NAME, STATUS, CLIENT))

actions.sql: INSERT INTO EVENT_DETAILS (ORG_ID, CONFIG_KEY, COMPONENT_NAME, REQUEST_ID, UPDATE_DATE, UPDATE_TIME, CLIENT, STATUS, EVENT_DATA, MESSAGE) SELECT UUID(), UUID(), CASE WHEN MOD(n, 100)=0 THEN 'health' ELSE 'other' END, UUID(), 20231001 + MOD(n, 30), MOD(n, 86400), UUID(), MOD(n, 5), CONCAT('event_', n), CONCAT('message_', n) FROM generated_numbers WHERE n <= 10000
SELECT * FROM EVENT_DETAILS WHERE COMPONENT_NAME = 'health' AND UPDATE_DATE = 20231001

INSERT INTO EVENT_DETAILS (ORG_ID, CONFIG_KEY, COMPONENT_NAME, REQUEST_ID, UPDATE_DATE, UPDATE_TIME, CLIENT, STATUS, EVENT_DATA, MESSAGE) VALUES (UUID(), UUID(), 'health', UUID(), 20231001, 3600, UUID(), 1, 'event_data', 'message')
DELETE FROM EVENT_DETAILS WHERE UPDATE_DATE < 20231015 AND COMPONENT_NAME = 'health'
